title: Align credential refresh windows, add pull-stream adapter, and bump cross-SDK versions
author: Maya Chen
ci_status: pass (lint + unit + integration passed; e2e flaky test rerun passed)
description: Motivation: teams using different Redwood SDKs observed small timing mismatches where near-expiry tokens caused sporadic 401s during stream reconnects and short-lived polling. This PR standardizes the refresh window semantics across TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs, and introduces a lightweight pull-stream adapter for iterator-style consumers to ease migration from callback-based streaming APIs. Changes are intentionally conservative: we keep the default refresh window behavior but expose a single cross-SDK configuration option (credentialRefreshMarginMs) and provide a compatibility shim for older consumer patterns. The PR also bumps the TypeScript SDK to v1.9.0, coordinates matching compatibility bumps in the Python and Go SDK packages, and adds migration notes.
commits: feat: expose credentialRefreshMarginMs and centralize token refresh timing (types & runtime)
chore: add pull-stream adapter and iterator helper for streaming responses
fix: guard reconnect path for rapid reauth races during stream handoff
chore(release): bump ts sdk to v1.9.0 and pin compat notes for py/go

release_notes:
- SDK: TypeScript v1.9.0 - exposes credentialRefreshMarginMs (default preserved) and adds pull-stream adapter for iterator-style consumers.
- Fixes a reconnect race where near-expiry tokens could cause transient 401s during stream handoff.
- Coordinated minor bumps and a compatibility shim in Python and Go SDKs to align refresh semantics.
- Migration docs added: docs/migrations/2026-03-token-refresh.md
notes: Backport not required; change is non-breaking by default. Teams using custom short refresh windows should validate their margin. The Go shim intentionally leaves behavior unchanged unless the new compat flag is enabled.
contributor_notes: This PR touches three SDKs; release script incremented package versions and staged artifacts. Hold release until internal announce email and cross-team migration window are scheduled.
manual_steps_for_ops:
- Coordinate the rollout for Dedicated customers with strict token lifetimes.
- For high-frequency reconnect workloads, recommend setting credentialRefreshMarginMs to at least 5000 ms.
- Watch streaming error rates for 24h after deploy.
